shared_style: rounded chibi game art, thick clean deep-brown outline, warm cozy cel shading, polished Chinese breakfast-stall palette
background: perfectly flat pure #ff00ff chroma-key background for local alpha extraction
shared_constraints: single production-ready item sprite; transparent final; no personification, face, text, logo, watermark, cast shadow, contact shadow, floor, reflection, steam, or background scene; no #ff00ff in subject; crisp silhouette and generous margin

prompt_templates.plain_soy_milk_master: Use the customer portrait as the immutable style anchor and the legacy plain cup for subject and composition. Create exactly one tapered cream paper cup with a teal rim in a three-quarter top-down view, filled with pale warm soy milk. No lid, straw, garnish, beans, steam, text, symbols, shadow, or extra objects. Apply the shared style, background, and constraints.
prompt_templates.soy_milk_variant: Use the accepted v2 plain cup as the invariant master. Preserve the exact cup body, teal rim, view, outline, lighting, placement, scale, and margin. Change only the soy-milk surface to {liquid} and add {garnish}, matching the legacy recipe reference. Keep every other aspect unchanged. Apply the shared background and constraints.
prompt_templates.plain_youtiao_master: Use the customer portrait as the immutable style anchor, the accepted v2 plain dough for ingredient-family language, and the legacy plain product for identity and composition. Create exactly two intact finished golden-orange fried youtiao sticks, parallel diagonally with a small gap, characteristic twin lobes and central grooves, fully visible and countable. No cut end, filling, toppings, container, steam, text, shadow, or extra object. Apply the shared style, background, and constraints.
prompt_templates.surface_youtiao_variant: Use the accepted v2 plain fried-youtiao master as an invariant. Preserve its exact two intact golden-orange sticks, diagonal arrangement, twin-lobe form, outline, lighting, scale, and margin. Change only the surfaces by adding {surface}, matching the legacy recipe reference. Apply the shared background and constraints.
prompt_templates.cut_youtiao_variant: Use the accepted v2 plain fried-youtiao master as the exterior invariant. Preserve the saturated golden-orange fried exterior, two-stick arrangement, twin-lobe form, outline, lighting, scale, and margin. Add only the specified small cut face and {filling}; keep all remaining exterior surfaces golden-orange. Apply the shared background and constraints.
